name: Dumbbell walking lunge

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Step out and drop your back knee

phases.name: bottom
phases.cue: Back knee just above the floor

phases.name: rise
phases.cue: Drive up through your front foot

phases.name: step
phases.cue: Step through into the next lunge

formTips: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall
Take a long step forward and lower until the back knee is just above the floor
Keep the front knee over the front foot and your torso upright
Drive up through the front foot and bring the back foot through into the next step
Alternate legs as you walk forward
commonMistakes: Taking short steps so the front knee shoots past the toes
Slamming the back knee into the floor
